summary: Tested the 20% Paras Mall delivery service charge (on MRP) end to end. Backend pytest: 8/8 passed. The mark-delivered endpoint creates a MALLDLV-{booking_id} charge (paras_mall_delivery, mrp basis, prc_amount 0, value = MRP 2500, 20%, amount 500, PENDING, details product_name/mrp_inr/booking_id/stage=delivery). The response includes service_charge {charge_id, amount, status}. A notification is created with action_url /my-service-charges and mentions the MRP. A second call returns 400 with no duplicate. Without auth it returns 401. A non-fulfilled booking returns 400. pending/{uid} returns has_pending=true. history returns details, and a legacy mall row with no details gets product_name and mrp_inr filled in from mall_bookings. Frontend /my-service-charges (mobile 390, user 9970100782): rows show the amount, the type chip ('Paras Mall Delivery', 'Paras Mall Booking', 'Qa Razorpay Loader') and 'View details'. Tapping a row expands Type/Product/Charged on/Service charge/Total/Status/Created/Reference/Charge ID: 'Product MRP ₹ 2500.00' for mrp basis, '1,000 PRC = ₹ 100.00' plus a Product MRP line for prc basis. Tapping again collapses it, and only one row is open at a time. Pay Now opens the Razorpay checkout (₹500, not paid). Admin /admin/mall Bookings > Mark Delivered: the confirm dialog mentions the '20% service charge on MRP (₹500.00)' and the toast says 'Marked delivered. ₹500.00 service charge (20% of MRP) created for the user.' The booking-time charge was checked by code review only (paras_mall.py ~795: paras_mall_booking, prc basis, details.product_name, stage=booking); no real booking was made, to avoid debiting PRC. All DB changes were restored.

minor.issue: Check-then-set race: it does find_one(status=='fulfilled') and then an update_one that does not filter on status. Two concurrent admin clicks can both pass, which duplicates the community_feed and community_posts entries. The charge itself is protected by the unique index on redemption_id. Suggested fix: update_one({booking_id, status:'fulfilled'}, ...) and return 400 if modified_count == 0.

Charge creation errors are swallowed (logging.warning). The booking still becomes 'delivered' with no charge, and the admin only sees the generic toast. Consider showing a warning in the response when service_charge is null but MRP > 0.

issues: The active 'Bookings (N)' pill was almost unreadable in the screenshot (light text on a light amber/white background) after a delivery. Check the active-state styling of admin-mall-tab-bookings.
The dialog amount is calculated in the browser as mrp*0.2. It ignores the configured service_charge_percent and min_service_charge_inr, so it could differ from the real charge if the config changes.

action_items: Optional: make mark-delivered atomic (conditional update on status 'fulfilled') to stop duplicate community posts
Optional: show the configured percent in the admin confirm dialog instead of a hardcoded 0.2
Optional: check the contrast of the active Bookings tab pill on the admin Paras Mall page
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing: /api/redemption-service-charge/history/{user_id} and /pending/{user_id} take no auth (anyone who knows a uid can read that user's charges; IDOR).
The notification text for base_inr charges is hardcoded to say 'has been delivered'. That is fine for its only caller today, but it will be worded wrongly if base_inr is reused elsewhere.
The enrichment in user_history strips 'MALLDLV-' and looks up mall_bookings for every mall row missing product_name. It is a single $in query, so that is fine.
